action.name: Open Terminal Here
action.description: Open a terminal window inside this directory

action.name: Open as Root
action.description: Open folder with administrative root privileges

action.name: Find in this Folder
action.command: /usr/bin/ptyxis --new-window --working-directory="%f" -e bash -c 'echo "Searching in %f..."; read -p "Search pattern: " query; find . -iname "*$query*" | less'
action.description: Search for files recursively within this directory

action.name: Compute SHA256 Checksum
action.command: /usr/bin/ptyxis --new-window -e bash -c 'echo "Computing SHA256 for: %n"; echo "---------------------------------------------"; sha256sum %f; echo "---------------------------------------------"; read -p "Press Enter to close..."'
action.description: Calculate SHA-256 hash of the selected file
